title: Boosting zero-shot learning through neuro-symbolic integration
abstract: arXiv:2611.30358v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Zero-shot learning (ZSL) aims to train deep neural networks to recognize objects from unseen classes, starting from a semantic description of the concepts. Neuro-symbolic (NeSy) integration refers to a class of techniques that incorporate symbolic knowledge representation and reasoning with the learning capabilities of deep neural networks. However, to date, few studies have explored how to leverage NeSy techniques to inject prior knowledge during the training process to boost ZSL capabilities. Here, we present Fuzzy Logic Prototypical Network (FLPN) that formulates the classification task as prototype matching in a visual-semantic embedding space, which is trained by optimizing a NeSy loss. Specifically, FLPN exploits the Logic Tensor Network (LTN) framework to incorporate background knowledge in the form of logical axioms by grounding a first-order logic language as differentiable operations between real tensors. translated_title: 通过神经符号整合增强零样本学习
translated_abstract: 零样本学习（ZSL）旨在训练深度神经网络，使其能够从概念的语义描述出发，识别来自未见类别的物体。神经符号整合是指一类将符号知识表示与推理同深度神经网络的学习能力相结合的技术。然而，迄今为止，很少有研究探索如何在训练过程中利用神经符号技术注入先验知识以提升零样本学习能力。本文提出了模糊逻辑原型网络（FLPN），它将分类任务表述为视觉-语义嵌入空间中的原型匹配，并通过优化神经符号损失进行训练。具体而言，FLPN利用逻辑张量网络（LTN）框架，通过将一阶逻辑语言落地为实张量之间的可微分运算，以逻辑公理的形式纳入背景知识。
tldr: 本文提出模糊逻辑原型网络（FLPN），利用逻辑张量网络框架将逻辑公理形式的背景知识注入训练过程，通过优化神经符号损失在视觉-语义嵌入空间中进行原型匹配，从而提升零样本学习能力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the Fuzzy Logic Prototypical Network (FLPN), which leverages the Logic Tensor Network framework to inject background knowledge in the form of logical axioms during training, optimizing a neuro-symbolic loss for prototype matching in a visual-semantic embedding space to boost zero-shot learning.
